A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown a new approach to the study of the memory switching effect in metal/VO 2 –silicon structures.
the electrical switching effect in the metal/VO2/Si structures with VO2 layers obtained by the sol-gel method is caused by the semiconductor-to-metal transition of the VO2 layer.

the memory switching in the metal/VO2/silicon structures is due to the semiconductor to metal phase transition (SMTP) in the VO2 film, and is associated with the oxygen ion electromigation in a SiOx layer formed at the interface of the VO2 and the Si substrate during the deposition process.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to obtain the memory switching effect with VO 2 thin films obtained by the acetylacetonato sol–gel method.
